title: Migration job status progression: blocked -> unblocked -> running
notes: Tests latest-state-wins without deleting history: the job passes through three distinct states in one session. A good extractor captures the CURRENT state (running, ETA ~2h) as the standing fact and should not leave 'blocked' as the extracted current status.

Update: DBA granted permissions, so the job is now UNBLOCKED and queued to start.
It's now actually RUNNING — kicked off five minutes ago, ETA 2 hours.
Got it — running now, ETA about 2 hours from now.
